name: Particles of Reality
source:
You play a character who will experience many lives in multiple alternate universes. Somehow, you are causing the destruction of reality. Can it be stopped, or will the Guardians kill you to protect the universe? Can you find your happily ever after... How many times will you die trying?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2128070/Particles_of_Reality/]Steam[/url]]
